evidence: Changes PSBT handling and walletprocesspsbt in src/psbt.cpp and src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp.
rationale: Enables users in collaborative PSBT workflows to sanitize sensitive derivation paths and xpubs before sharing transactions. As noted in #30294, 'Setting bip32derivs to false with walletprocesspsbt includes bip32_derivs for outputs', leaving no straightforward way to strip existing metadata.
